Dressing in Ways That Feel Good

For anyone who wants getting dressed to feel easier and kinder. Each day is one small way to choose clothes that feel comfortable, care for what you already own and enjoy how you show up in the world, whatever your shape or budget.

Self-Care · Self-Care · Self-Esteem · Body · one to-do a day · you choose how many days

Start this challenge free

The first seven days

  • Day 1Put on one soft, cozy thing you already own today and simply notice how it feels.
  • Day 2Lay one soft shirt on a chair tonight, so tomorrow begins with a single easy choice already made.
  • Day 3Pick one piece of clothing you love and give it a gentle shake and a smooth with your hands before you put it away.
  • Day 4Pick out the most cheerful color in your closet and wear it somewhere you will see it.
  • Day 5Say one kind word to yourself as you pull on your socks this morning.
  • Day 6Run your fingertips over three fabrics in your closet and notice which one feels kindest on your skin.
  • Day 7Choose three outfits you always feel at ease in and call them your go-to looks for rushed mornings.

Further into the year

The to-dos keep changing as the year goes on. A few from later in this theme:

  • Day 30Try on your interview outfit at home and sit, stand and reach in it to check it moves easily with you.
  • Day 60Gather three things you no longer wear and put them in a bag by the door for donation.
  • Day 120Wrap up in your coziest layers on an autumn evening and step outside for a short, easy stroll.
  • Day 240Shop your own closet first for a wedding outfit, before thinking about buying anything new.
  • Day 365Before bed, set out tomorrow's clothes with a kind thought for the person who will wear them.

How a challenge works

A Theraglee challenge is a theme with one small to-do for every day of a year. You choose how long yours runs, anywhere from a week to the full year, and each day you get the next to-do: something that takes a few minutes and fits inside an ordinary day. Tick it off when it is done. Nothing is scored and nothing is lost if you miss a day; the next to-do is simply waiting when you come back.

Challenges come with a free Theraglee account, which never asks for a card. Your progress stays private to you.
